what: Nine flat people form one strip that walks endlessly to the right — the stride is 1.2s cut into 29 steps (steps) so they step in jerks, and the strip flows one tile width (strip height × 7.54) in 20s linearly (linear). For laying People Passing on the Street at the footer bottom, on empty screens (404) and at the head of application flows

options.steps: Number of frames per step, default 29
options.--fx-loop: Duration of one section flowing past (seconds, via style·media query), default 20 — 12 for the street-illustration-fintech-landing phone
options.--fx-tile: One-sheet width = Band height × this value, default 7.54 (original 1206×160)
options.dir: If left, walks to the left
options.--fx-h · --fx-h-wide: Band height — 80px on phone · 160px at 768px and up
options.--fx-c1…--fx-c5 · --fx-skin: Five Skin colors and a flesh tone, plus the defaults --kf-accent · --kf-ink · --kf-dim · --kf-accent-soft · --kf-line · --kf-raised

note: The original uses one person sprite image (30 frames). This person is drawn on a canvas at the same tempo without an image file, so the silhouette is simple — if you have a brand illustration, swap it into the image slot. It stops when off screen.

from.where: shared.css .th-walk (white strip at the very bottom of the footer: phone 80px·12s, wide screens 160px·20s)
